title: Stale instructor-course links survive rebuilds and keep influencing course scores

evidence.quote:
contexts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT term_id, subject, number, instructor_name
  FROM split
  WHERE instructor_name <> ''
)

INSERT INTO instructor_course_links (
  term_id, subject, number, instructor_name,
  gpa_id, rmp_id, confidence_score, match_method
)
...
ON CONFLICT(term_id, subject, number, instructor_name) DO UPDATE SET

FROM courses c
LEFT JOIN instructor_course_links l
  ON l.term_id = CAST(c.year AS TEXT) || '-' || c.term
  AND l.subject = c.subject
  AND l.number = c.number

reasoning: The rebuild computes the current instructor contexts and upserts them, but it never removes instructor_course_links rows that are no longer present in courses.primary_instructor. enrichCoursesWithScores then joins every link for the course/term/number, so an old instructor's RMP/GPA evidence remains in the AVG after the course's primary instructor changes or disappears.
reproduction: Have CS 225 initially linked to instructor A, then sync the same term with primary_instructor changed to instructor B. rebuildInstructorCourseLinks inserts/updates B but leaves A. enrichCoursesWithScores averages both A and B ratings for the course.
recommendation: Replace links for each rebuilt term atomically: delete instructor_course_links for the term/course contexts not present in the new contexts, or rebuild the term's link rows inside a transaction before recomputing scores.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included enrichment test only verifies that set-based rebuild SQL is invoked and scores are recomputed once; it does not seed a stale link and assert it is pruned.
suggestedRegressionTest: Seed instructor_course_links with an old instructor for a course, mock current courses.primary_instructor with a different instructor, run rebuildInstructorCourseLinks/enrichCoursesWithScores, and assert only the current instructor contributes to linked_rmp_rating/difficulty.
minimumFixScope: apps/api/src/services/enrichment.ts link rebuild and score recomputation path.
